card.name: Inside brand and company names
card.fires_on: The word just before the end of a multi-part drug or company name, such as the second piece of a brand name or the salt or form word after a generic name. It also fires on a few adverbs before a drug-label phrase.

modes.label: Brand name pieces
modes.description: A middle piece of a capitalized brand name, where more letters of the name follow.
modes.example: Avoid administration of SPIRIVA RESPIM<<AT>> with other anticholinergic-containing drugs

modes.label: Generic name plus form or salt
modes.description: A salt or form word after a generic drug name, with a hyphenated or dose term following.
modes.example: Esomeprazole<< magnesium>> 40 mg Once Daily for

modes.label: Company name
modes.description: The abbreviation Co within a pharmaceutical company name.
modes.example: a subsidiary of Merck &<< Co>>., Inc.’s Emend LLC’s
